questions.question: A bar graph shows Feb 45, Mar 60, Apr 30, May 75 books. How many more in May than April, and what is the mean per month?
A pie chart of 200 learners has a 72° slice for netball. How many chose netball?
Explain how a vertical axis starting at 96 can mislead.
questions.expected_answer: It cuts off the bottom of every bar, so small differences look huge; values of 98 and 102 look far apart though they differ by only about 4%.
